summary: Admit Claude (Anthropic) on the existing tenant-scoped AI provider surface through the host-owned Messages API transport.

impacts.evidence: Claude reuses the existing tenant/workspace-scoped AI provider account and governance boundary; no provider-owned tenancy data is introduced.
Only the governed caller-assembled prompt leaves the tenant boundary; keys and responses are not persisted by the connector.
Existing AI provider operations are reused and their provider enum is widened additively to include claude.
No event name or payload is added or changed.
Adds one SDK v1 provider manifest with ai.completion.generate; provider dispatch remains isolated in builtinruntime.
Migration 000020 widens the ai_provider_accounts provider CHECK constraint without rewriting rows or secrets.
Anthropic x-api-key bytes are callback-scoped and all egress uses the common DNS-pinned public-HTTPS transport.
Existing AI governance, data-class, capability and audit checks remain mandatory before analysis egress.
Existing AI provider account and analysis audit entries are reused without secret or prompt payloads.
AI completion performs no remote commerce synchronization or durable remote write.
Adds outbound Messages API egress only; no inbound webhook surface is admitted.
Manifest timeout/concurrency/retry metadata and bounded normalized errors cover provider availability.
The account can be disabled immediately and the additive provider CHECK migration has no destructive rollback requirement.
Claude package tests cover request/auth/response boundaries and the retained Task-064 conformance report validates all required checks.
